content.introduction: Canvas is the university's Learning Management System where you access course materials, submit assignments, participate in discussions, and check your grades.

sections.title: Getting Started
sections.content:
Logging In:
1. Use your university username and password
2. Complete two-factor authentication
3. You'll see your Dashboard with all enrolled courses

First Time Setup:
- Set notification preferences
- Add profile picture
- Configure calendar sync
- Download the mobile app

sections.title: Course Navigation
sections.content:
Common Course Areas:
- Home: Course overview and announcements
- Modules: Organized course content by week/topic
- Assignments: All graded work with due dates
- Discussions: Class forums and conversations
- Grades: Your scores and feedback
- Files: Downloadable course materials
- Syllabus: Course outline and policies

sections.title: Submitting Assignments
sections.content:
How to Submit:
1. Click on the assignment
2. Read all instructions carefully
3. Click 'Submit Assignment'
4. Upload file or enter text
5. Click 'Submit' to finalize

Important Notes:
- Check file format requirements
- Note the due date and time (usually 11:59 PM)
- You can resubmit until the deadline (usually)
- Save drafts frequently

sections.title: Communication Tools
sections.content:
Inbox:
- Message instructors and classmates
- Receive course announcements
- Get assignment feedback

Discussions:
- Participate in class forums
- Reply to peers
- Follow discussion threads

Announcements:
- Important course updates
- Check regularly or enable notifications

sections.title: Mobile App
sections.content:
Canvas Student App:
- Available for iOS and Android
- View courses and assignments
- Submit work from your phone
- Receive push notifications
- Check grades on the go

Features:
- Offline viewing for some content
- Calendar integration
- Audio/video submissions

content.conclusion: Check Canvas daily for updates. Enable notifications so you never miss an announcement or deadline.

content.introduction: The IT Help Desk provides technical support for all university technology services including accounts, WiFi, software, and devices.

sections.title: Contact Information
sections.content:
Phone: (555) 123-4600
Email: helpdesk@university.edu

Locations:
- Main Help Desk: Library, 1st Floor
- Tech Hub: Student Union, Room 120

Hours:
Monday-Friday: 8AM-8PM
Saturday-Sunday: 12PM-5PM
24/7 Chat and Email Support

sections.title: Common Services
sections.content:
Account Support:
- Password resets
- Account lockouts
- Multi-factor authentication setup
- Email configuration

Network Support:
- WiFi connection issues
- Ethernet registration
- VPN access
- Network storage

Software Support:
- Installation assistance
- Licensing questions
- Compatibility issues

sections.title: Self-Service Options
sections.content:
Password Reset:
- Use the self-service portal
- Answer security questions
- Or call the automated phone line

Knowledge Base:
- Searchable solutions
- Step-by-step guides
- Video tutorials
- FAQ section

sections.title: Response Times
sections.content:
Emergency (system down): 1 hour
High Priority (can't work): 4 hours
Medium Priority (workaround available): 1 business day
Low Priority (questions): 2 business days

Note: During peak times (start of semester, finals) expect longer wait times.

content.conclusion: Before contacting the Help Desk, check the knowledge base for quick solutions. Many common issues have step-by-step guides.

content.introduction: As a student, you have access to a wide range of free and discounted software to support your academic work.

sections.title: Microsoft Office 365
sections.content:
What's Included:
- Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook
- OneNote, Teams, OneDrive (1TB storage)
- Access, Publisher (Windows only)

How to Access:
1. Log in with your university credentials
2. Download apps or use online versions
3. Install on up to 5 devices

Features:
- Cloud storage and sync
- Real-time collaboration
- Access continues while enrolled

sections.title: Adobe Creative Cloud
sections.content:
What's Included:
- Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign
- Premiere Pro, After Effects
- Acrobat Pro, XD
- All Creative Cloud apps

Access:
- Available on all lab computers
- Personal license: $20/year through bookstore

sections.title: Programming Tools
sections.content:
Development Software:
- Visual Studio (free for students)
- JetBrains IDEs (free professional licenses)
- MATLAB (free university license)
- GitHub Education Pack

Cloud Credits:
- AWS education credits
- Azure student account
- Google Cloud credits

sections.title: Security Software
sections.content:
Antivirus:
- Free antivirus for personal devices
- Required for network access

VPN Service:
- Access campus resources off-campus
- Secure connection on public WiFi

Password Manager:
- LastPass premium (free for students)

sections.title: Specialty Software
sections.content:
Statistical Analysis:
- SPSS (lab computers, discounted personal)
- R and RStudio (free)
- Stata (lab computers)

Design and Engineering:
- AutoCAD (free student license)
- SolidWorks (lab computers)
- SketchUp (free online version)

content.conclusion: Don't pay for software you can get free! Check the IT software portal regularly - new software is added each semester.
